title: A session that started other sessions never opens the question box
why: Your feedback, Oct 27 15:51 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh21vJLZeSrqXyLEvzPyoXgLz): the Banchi orchestrator opened the question box because none of its own agents or commands were running, and blocked while the lane sessions it had started waited on it to route answers and merge.
note: The rule is the problem: questions-go-to-owner bars the box while "an agent, a lane or a background command" runs, and c86's check (session-board mod, PR 665) counts only the session's own agents, commands and workflows, never the separate sessions it started. Fix: an orchestrator, meaning any session that has started another session or lane, asks on the waiting page only and never opens the box; the rule says so in one line, and the mod refuses AskUserQuestion once the session has started a session (start_session or a lane spawn recorded on its board). Red first on a session with a live started session and no running agent. Needs no answer. Port: no; the rule and the mod install from claude-settings. Placed ahead of c148 (triage, Oct 27): one open box stalled every lane under that orchestrator. Green and reviewed: draft PR #729 (b15addf, 3 review rounds), waits for the next batch; a successful start_session or create_session refuses the box for the rest of the session, red then 144 of 144 green. Low notes for docs/debts/notes.md: a started: record stays forever when its sess: entry cannot be read; an orchestrator stopped over a day may lose its count at the next sweep.
